title: Stability for a formally determined Lorentzian inverse problem
summary: We consider the inverse problem of recovering a potential $q$, depending on space and time, in the wave equation $(\Box_g+q)u=0$ on a Lorentzian manifold. We prove Lipschitz stability for a formally determined version of this problem under a \textit{null-cone foliation} assumption. As a consequence, we obtain uniqueness for the Lorentzian Calderón problem in a fixed conformal class. Our approach uses distorted spherical waves.
